title: Futex PI Linux rt_mutex priority-tree model
summary: Replace Tx futex PI's vector-scan donation model with a Linux-style per-lock priority waiter tree and per-task pi_waiters top-waiter model.

write_sets.notes: Single-agent rt_mutex-model slice in codex/futex-linux-compat worktree.

steps.title: Add scheduler task pi_waiters API and tests
steps.notes: Added PiLockToken, PriorityKey, upsert/remove pi_waiter APIs, and task effective-priority-key queries. Existing donation tokens now map onto legacy pi_waiter keys rather than a separate donation vector.

steps.title: Expose task pi_waiters through reactor_priority seam
steps.notes: The seam now exposes upsert_pi_waiter, remove_pi_waiter, and task_effective_priority_key alongside the compatibility donation facade.

steps.title: Replace futex PI vector table with per-lock priority trees
steps.notes: FutexPiTable now maps each FutexKey to FutexPiLockState with waiters_by_order, waiters_by_id, cached top_waiter, owner_tid, stable waiter IDs, waiter TaskKey, and blocked_on_key metadata.

steps.title: Retarget handoff, cancel, timeout, and requeue to top-waiter model
steps.notes: Unlock pops the cached top waiter, removes the old owner's pi_waiters entry, transfers remaining top donation to the new owner, and wakes only the handed-off waiter. Cancel and timeout remove waiter rows by source id and propagate deboost through blocked-owner chains.

steps.title: Run verification and progress catch-up
steps.notes: Progress artifacts record the rt_mutex-model implementation and remaining evidence gap.

Helper built the static RV64 musl PTHREAD_PRIO_INHERIT condvar test, injected a private sdcard copy, ran it through basic_testcode.sh, observed PASS pthread-pi-condvar, wrapper return 0, guest exit 0, and no trap lines.
No scause/sepc/stval trap lines found; expected negative trap evidence for the clean guest run.

risks: PriorityKey currently models RT priority and FIFO order; SCHED_DEADLINE ordering is represented as future API space, not runtime-complete behavior.
The explicit guest pthread PI-condvar evidence is currently a private-image injected helper, not an OSComp judge-integrated suite.
Queued task ordering observes effective RT priority at pick time; this avoids stale queue order but is still Phase 1 queue scanning, not a full RT runqueue.
